objective: Keep the existing project-member and workflow-definition list APIs compatible while bounding their database work and making their performance observable.

requirements.statement: Project member roles are queried in one tenant-bound batch after the member query.
acceptance: A member-list request performs one member query and one role batch query
Ordering, role contents, avatar URLs, authorization results, and empty-list behavior remain unchanged
counterexample: A role query is issued for each returned member

requirements.statement: Workflow definition lists use stored summaries without selecting definition_json.
acceptance: The definition-list Mapper SQL does not select definition_json
The existing requires_configuration response value reflects the latest version summary
counterexample: The list query fetches definition_json and removes it from the response

requirements.statement: Workflow definition summaries are backfilled and remain synchronized with all affected version write paths in the same transaction.
acceptance: Migration backfill matches the latest version projection
Create, edit, copy, and publish write paths refresh latest_version_no and requires_configuration
counterexample: A copied or edited draft exposes a stale summary

requirements.statement: Both read paths publish timing metrics using only fixed low-cardinality tags.
acceptance: Tags contain only operation, scope_type, and outcome values and contain no business identifiers
counterexample: A tenant, user, project, definition, request, or JSON value is a metric tag

requirements.statement: Tenant isolation, service-layer authorization, pagination, auditing, public API contracts, and current_version semantics remain unchanged.
acceptance: Regression checks retain authorized and denied behavior and existing response fields
counterexample: A Mapper bypasses service authorization or reads records across tenants

invariants: No public REST API or frontend response-shape change
Service layer retains authentication, RBAC, project access, pagination response assembly, and audit responsibilities
Flyway migrations are append-only and target MySQL 8.4
Metric tags do not contain high-cardinality or sensitive identifiers
constraints: Only files authorized by REQ-20260911-076 codex-task-scope.yaml may be changed
The change spans approved platform/system, platform/workflow, platform/infrastructure, and boot configuration surfaces
No production access or sensitive data
Module and package names remain unchanged
non_goals: Caching, Redis, cursor pagination, Outbox, or attachment cleanup changes
REST API, JWT, RBAC, or frontend changes

assumptions.text: Module-local MyBatis-Plus starter dependencies can discover annotated Mapper interfaces and classpath mapper XML resources.
assumptions.basis: Root POM manages MyBatis-Plus 3.5.12 and application-local.yml already configures mapper-locations.
assumptions.falsifier: Focused Maven startup or Mapper tests fail resource discovery.

unknowns.question: Whether legacy definition JSON contains placeholder variants outside the current Java projection logic.
unknowns.impact: A SQL-only migration backfill might disagree with application behavior.

decisions.question: Should the latest workflow-version summary reuse current_version?
Should the data-access migration cover all services?
options: Migrate only the two approved read clusters
decisions.selected: Migrate only the two approved read clusters

measurement_intents.observable: Mapper delegation, a single batch role lookup, and member response equivalence
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: System service/Mapper tests and local API probe

measurement_intents.observable: Definition-list XML excludes definition_json and returns summary values
Migration and each version writer produce matching summaries
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: MySQL Flyway integration and lifecycle tests

measurement_intents.observable: Both timers and their bounded tag keys are visible through Actuator
Tenant-bound Mapper predicates and service authorization behavior remain intact
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: Regression tests and targeted API authorization checks
